name: player_update_top_down_camera_state
description: Player::UpdateTopDownCameraState derives the top-down camera target from world position plus the state-2 target offset, updates the active camera node, and fixes the camera direction downward.
known_limits: Binary Ninja disassembly/HLIL for 0x4057d0 validates fastcall ECX=saveState, playerState load, cameraTarget = worldPos + cameraState2TargetOffset, gwCameraSetTarget, fixed gwCameraSetPosition(-1.54999995f, 0.0f, 0.0f), and cameraDir = {0.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f}.
The native smoke verifies the target vector stored on player state and the active camera node, the fixed camera-position setter values, and the downward camera direction.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x4057d0 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player camera/source-cluster pass.
